svg.text: Ramp → OpenAccountants · expense-deductibility demo [MOCK (set OA_MCP_TOKEN + RAMP creds to go live)]
💳 The Ledbury · GBP 240.00 · "Dinner with client ACME Ltd" [GB · Meals & Entertainment]
OpenAccountants → United Kingdom — expense deductibility & VAT recovery (tier 1, signed off by James Power (UK lead))
⚠️ NOT deductible · VAT blocked
Client/business entertaining is not deductible for UK corporation tax (CTA 2009 s1298) and input VAT is blocked.
→ flag for review before it's booked as deductible
💳 Figma · GBP 144.00 · "Design tool subscription" [GB · Software & Web Services]
OpenAccountants → United Kingdom — expense deductibility & VAT recovery (tier 1, signed off by James Power (UK lead))
✅ Deductible · VAT recoverable
Wholly-and-exclusively business cost; input VAT recoverable on a valid VAT invoice.
💳 Joe's Grill · USD 120.00 · "Lunch with prospect re: Q3 deal" [US · Meals]
OpenAccountants → United States — business expense deductibility (tier 1, signed off by Amir Pelinkovic (US lead))
ℹ️ Only 50% deductible — document business purpose
Business meals 50% deductible (IRC §274(n)); keep business-purpose documentation.
💳 Ticketmaster · USD 600.00 · "NBA tickets with client" [US · Entertainment]
OpenAccountants → United States — business expense deductibility (tier 1, signed off by Amir Pelinkovic (US lead))
⚠️ NOT deductible
Entertainment is non-deductible post-TCJA (IRC §274(a)).
→ flag for review before it's booked as deductible
💳 Staples · USD 85.00 · "Printer paper + toner" [US · Office Supplies]
OpenAccountants → United States — business expense deductibility (tier 1, signed off by Amir Pelinkovic (US lead))
✅ Deductible
Ordinary & necessary business expense (IRC §162).
